cross_training.description: A non-running aerobic session used to maintain fitness while reducing running impact.

easy_run.label: Easy Run
easy_run.description: An easy aerobic run done at a comfortable, conversational pace to build endurance while limiting fatigue.

race.description: A race effort or tune-up event used to practice pacing and measure current fitness.
